about: The queue plugin's texts and hooks, run by plugins/queue/tests/queue.rs. describe: the queue tool's text from the gate's status reply. wrap and env: how sessions run under claude-queue ({lib} and {run} are the test's folders). triggers: whether a queue_wait target is valid.

describe.name: a holder and two waiters
describe.want:
L3 holds the turn: pid 4242 (shikigami npu-dma) python bench.py --long, /dev/accel/accel0 for 10 min
Waiting, in order:
- pid 99 (seimei (you)) make gpu, /dev/kfd for 30s
- pid 7 (other) ./run, /dev/dri/renderD128 for 10s

describe.name: a holder whose processes ended
describe.want:
L1 holds the turn: pid 5 (seimei (you)) x, /dev/kfd for 1 min
Its processes are gone; the turn passes on in a few seconds.
Nothing waits.

describe.name: free
describe.want:
Nobody holds the GPU/NPU turn.
Nothing waits.

describe.name: cqd answers instead
describe.want: Another daemon (claude-queue's cqd) holds the queue socket; seimei's queue starts once it stops.
